title: Frame/legacy parity checklist — true tool station landed, planner loop now dispatches real tools with write approval and ask_user relay

acceptance.fifteenTools: fourteen executor calls plus the ask_user relay cover the fifteen legacy tools with output and success always present; FifteenToolsDispatchWithFullCardFields
acceptance.unknownIsolation: unknown tool names stay inside tool.end errorCode UNKNOWN_TOOL with a TOOL_DENIED contract envelope and never touch NOT_FOUND; UnknownToolStaysInsideToolDenied
acceptance.safetyMapping: PATH_DENIED and PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE both map onto the TOOL_DENIED contract code; SafetyViolationsShareOneDeniedMapping
acceptance.spillShaping: outputs past 64k spill to a session-temp relative path with truncated counts on card and history; OversizedOutputSpillsWithObservableTruncation
acceptance.execTimeout: timeout_ms accepts 1..300000 ms, rejects out-of-range as INVALID_TIMEOUT, and slow calls surface as isolated TOOL_TIMEOUT; ExecTimeoutBoundariesAndIsolation
acceptance.writeApproval: write tools raise tool.confirm with argsPreview/policy/timeoutSec and resume after a keyed approval; WriteToolsPauseForApprovalAndResume
acceptance.rejectEndsChain: rejected write approval ends the tool chain with tool.end TOOL_DENIED and turn.cancelled reason rejected; RejectedWriteEndsTheChainAsRejected
acceptance.keyedAnswers: answers without or with a wrong toolCallId fail NOT_FOUND while the exact key resolves; AnswersVerifyThePendingCallKey
acceptance.askRelay: ask_user confirm carries questions, questionYaml, ticketId and sessionId, and the answer ticket is verified; AskUserCarriesQuestionsAndTicket
acceptance.askYaml: questionsYaml passes through with the ticket intact; AskUserYamlPassthroughKeepsTheTicket
acceptance.subDenial: nested spawn and ask_user from a sub role are denied inside TOOL_DENIED without reaching the backend; SubRoleDeniesNestedSpawnAndAsk
acceptance.emissionCodes: TOOL_DENIED and TOOL_TIMEOUT each fire at least once across the tool suite (tool.end errorCode plus contract envelope)
acceptance.rollback: clearing the runner falls back to the deferred tool.start/tool.end placeholder; echo-path suites stay green with no runner configured

history.note: session.list/get paged read matches legacy; workspace-scoped, no silent full scan (inherited, still green)
role=tool rows now carry toolCallId, name, 8k-capped persisted text, images, validated warnings and errorCode
session.delete removes child sessions too — scheduled with the cutover station
list/get filter by workspace, no silent full scan; tool station resolves workspace, role and parent per descriptor
frame page maps to render messages (inherited, still green)
prompt echo plus matching turn.done settle and incremental catch-up (inherited, still green)

tool.note: tool.start carries argsPreview/policy, tool.delta fires at most once per oversized call, tool.end carries success/output/exitCode/durationMs/fileBytes/errorCode/errorPayload/spilledFile/images/validatedWarnings/truncated
write approval and ask_user confirm carry argsPreview/policy/timeoutSec/sessionId; ask_user additionally carries questions/questionYaml/ticketId
engine returns the [SUBAGENT_INTERNAL] marker shape with parent linkage; sub-session Barrier fan-out and CancelTree stay on the legacy chain until the cancel station

turn.note: agent.prompt and agent.retry both run the detached loop with live deltas and real tool dispatch when the gateway and runner handles are set
single-turn cancel stays on the fastest path; tree cancel lands with the cancel station
turn.failed keeps the frozen reason set; tool misses and safety violations stay on tool.end and never leak into NOT_FOUND

usage.note: loop records real input/output tokens per round; budget bar wiring lands with the settings station
